outcome: Frontal cortex volume (total, white, grey matter)
cohort: The study involved preterm lambs delivered via caesarean section at 129 days' gestation, with a control group and two groups receiving different doses of postnatal dexamethasone for seven days.
finding: Postnatal dexamethasone treatment in preterm lambs did not appear to adversely affect neurodevelopment, showing no associations with lesion incidence or frontal cortex and hippocampal volumes.
